correctness.rationale: PASS: For every stated (r,t) the disk and point fit in a common open hemisphere, making the minimal geodesic convex hull well-defined. Spherical right-triangle sine/cosine laws yield tangent angles u=acos(tan(r) cos(t)/sin(t)) and v=asin(sin(r)/sin(t)); the two triangle spherical excesses minus the facing spherical disk sector give added area Delta=2u cos r+2v-pi. Differentiation yields Delta′=2 sin r(cos r-cos t)/(sin t sqrt(sin^2 t-sin^2 r))>0, checked independently at multiple interior parameters with 1e-15 agreement. Expanding the positive denominator near t=r and t=pi-r and integrating gives Delta(r+h)=(2/3)sqrt(2tan r)h^(3/2)+O(h^(5/2)) and terminal deficit=4sqrt(2cot r)h^(1/2)+O(h^(3/2)); monotone inversion gives h~tan(r)*deficit^2/32. Sampled gnomonic spherical hulls in checker.py are corroboration, not a proof of the continuous hull.
